title: Medevac of missing boater from Clearwater, Fla.
description: CLEARWATER, Fla.- Crewmembers from Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater, Fla., and the Coast Guard Cutter Tornado rescue Nick Schuyler from an overturned vessel 35 miles west of  Tampa Bay, Fla., Monday, March 2, 2009. Watchstanders at Coast Guard Sector St. Petersburg, Fla., received a call Sunday around 1:30 a.m. reporting that four friends, Schuyler, Victor "Marquis" Cooper, Corey Smith and William Bleakley did not return from their fishing trip. (Coast Guard video)
